samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Pulse Detection Logic</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="INITIAL">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STATE_1">State after detecting first '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STATE_2">State after detecting second '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="END">End state after detecting third '0'.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="state" width_description="reg [1:0];">Current state of the pulse detection process.</register>
        <wire id="next_state">Next state based on current state and data_in.</wire>
        
        // State transitions
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)>
            if (~rst_n) begin
                state <= INITIAL;
                data_out <= 0;
            end else begin
                state <= next_state;
            end
        </always>
        
        // Next state logic
        <assign next_state = (state == INITIAL && data_in == 1'b1) ? STATE_1 :
                            (state == STATE_1 && data_in == 1'b1) ? STATE_2 :
                            (state == STATE_2 && data_in == 1'b0) ? END :
                            INITIAL;
        
        // Output logic
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)>    
            if (~rst_n) begin
                data_out <= 0;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    INITIAL: data_out <= 0;
                    STATE_1: data_out <= 0;
                    STATE_2: data_out <= 0;
                    END:     data_out <= 1;
                endcase
            end
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block sensitive to the positive edge of the clk signal and the negative edge of the rst_n signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset state and data_out to default values
                state <= INITIAL;
                data_out <= 0;
            end else begin
                // Update state and data_out based on the conditions defined below
                case (state)
                    INITIAL: begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b1) begin
                            state <= STATE_1;
                        end
                        data_out <= 0;
                    end
                    
                    STATE_1: begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b1) begin
                            state <= STATE_2;
                        end else begin
                            state <= INITIAL;
                        end
                        data_out <= 0;
                    end
                    
                    STATE_2: begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b0) begin
                            state <= END;
                        end else begin
                            state <= INITIAL;
                        end
                        data_out <= 0;
                    end
                    
                    END: begin
                        state <= INITIAL;
                        data_out <= 1;
                    end
                    
                    default: begin
                        state <= INITIAL;
                        data_out <= 0;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
